description: IJsselstein maintains an urban fruit-tree collection as a living laboratory for climate adaptation. Inventory mapping, ecosystem-service assessment, grafting and water-management measures support conservation of crop diversity and urban green space. The resource is documented by European Environment Agency, Climate-ADAPT (case-study publisher). The application is located in IJsselstein. This is a narrative case, not a regularly gridded or periodically sampled dataset; intervention dates and later updates are given in the source. The case narrative is freely readable as a web page. A licence for reusing the underlying project data is not established. Reported interventions and projected benefits must be distinguished; the case does not supply a ready-to-run simulation. It can inform green-blue infrastructure adaptation scenarios, intervention assumptions and institutional constraints. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
